classes: RS-S015 singles (pi^k, k = 1..5, 20 smallest primary primes); rational normalization; prime moduli

predictions.text: K1 = mean s over k = 1 singles with N <= 43 (14 classes). Strong form (F(0+) = 1): K1(4e6) > K1(1e6) + 0.01 = 0.9712 and K1(4e6) > K1(2e6), with K1(4e6) <= 1.05: RISING. Plateau alternative: |K1(4e6) - 0.9612| <= 0.01: LEVEL. Otherwise UNDECIDED.
New-scale holdout of the crossover law: for every half-decade bin of log10 t (pooled over both X) with >= 4 singles having k <= 4 and an F prediction, |mean s - mean F| <= 0.12.
At each X, mean s over pi^5 singles with t >= 3 lies in [-1.15, -0.85].

power_note: Random-phase sd of r scales as D^(-1/2): about 0.0011 at X = 2e6 and 0.0008 at 4e6, so sigma_eps about 0.002 and sigma_s about 0.002-0.003 for k = 1 (SE of K1 about 0.001); pi^5 classes with t >= 3 have sigma_s about 0.03-0.07 each.
